__compat.description: Get the shared data set by `lynx.setSharedData()` used on pages belonging to the same LynxGroup.

web_lynx.notes: The shared store is scoped to one background Web Worker. Cards only share it when the host opts them into the same group via the `lynx-group-id` attribute (`lynxGroupId`) on `<lynx-view>`; without it every card gets its own worker and therefore its own store. Implemented since `@lynx-js/web-core@0.11.0`.
